personality.description: This person is moderately curious and willing to try new things, but usually prefers familiar routines and a sense of stability. In daily habits, they tend to act spontaneously, adapt quickly when plans change, and sometimes become disorganized or overlook deadlines and details. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually want to be fair and cooperative at first, but if their values are challenged they will firmly defend their own position and may worry intensely about the consequences. In group discussions, they speak in a balanced way, listening and contributing comfortably, though their tone can become tense or repetitive when they are stressed and overthinking a problem.
